message_problems: Slot (c) example 'so people can only call' (EN, HI and GU) is not literally what was seen: Krishna Auto Coating and Krishna Xtreme have a WhatsApp booking link on Maps, and the published numbers are mobiles. Say only 'no website button'.

Slot (b) 'your last 3 Google reviews have no reply' is false for 5 leads: Krishna Auto Coating (1 of 3 answered), Dwarkesh (1 of 3), RRR (2 of 3), Walker's (3 of 3), DNX (3 of 3). It is true for Detailing Xpert, Krishna Xtreme, Arihant, Carx Care and Motors Inn.

[Name]: no owner name was found for any lead. Do not take a first name from a review; those are staff or customers, not confirmed owners.

Any mention of their ads, offers, prices or 'nothing behind the ad' is a claim about their ads. Krishna Auto Coating, Detailing Xpert, Walker's, DNX and Motors Inn all run Meta ads now, so keep the slot on the Google or site page only, and never reuse prices from Walker's ad.

Day 3 offers a studio-specific 30-second sample: that is offer talk and an unproven outcome unless it is already built. Have it ready before sending. The 'second thing I noticed' must also be literally seen, for example Krishna Xtreme: the website link inside its Linktree returns 404 (28 Oct).
Day 7 'busy season' is an assumption about their business, not something seen; soften to 'if now is a busy time'.
Krishna Auto Coating and Krishna Xtreme look like one brand: send one message to one number, not two, and match the slot to the listing that number belongs to.
summary: All 11 checked on 28 Oct 2026. Sources: Maps data via Apify place-ID scrape (WebFetch of Maps returns an empty page), sites via WebFetch and curl, ads via the Apify Ad Library scraper. Phones, ratings, review counts, no-website and reply claims all matched; no listing is marked closed. 10 are usable; Exotic is held back: it is a brand claiming 7+ Gujarat studios with an HQ and websites, and its ads name no city or phone. Changes: Walker's, DNX and Motors Inn also run Meta ads now (lead text said unchecked or unknown); only 1 of Detailing Xpert's 2 ads is Diwali; Krishna Xtreme's Linktree website link is a 404 and its Facebook link is the page running Krishna Auto Coating's ad, so treat as one brand and message once; Arihant had only 1 review in 12 months, so trading is unconfirmed. Suggested order: spend seen first (Krishna, Detailing Xpert, Walker's, DNX, Motors Inn). Limits: one-day snapshot; 'no active ad found' only means no hit for the exact name; whether each number is on WhatsApp and who decides cannot be tested without contact. The three templates contain no price, free, instant, every, guarantee or result claim; the problems are in the slots below.
